Klean by Geerho User Manual

Welcome to Klean by Geerho. This guide covers everything you need as a customer: signing up, washing, paying, and earning free loads. Klean works on iPhone, iPad, Android phones and tablets, and in your web browser.

Getting started

1. Sign in

Open Klean and choose Continue with Apple, Continue with Google, or Continue with GitHub.

Klean is one person, one account. If you've used Klean before, sign in the same way you did then. You can add other sign-in methods later in Account → Sign-in methods.

2. Verify your identity

Everyone on Klean verifies once: customers, staff and owners alike. It keeps accounts real and stops points abuse.

  1. Pay the verification fee: a small in-app purchase in the iPhone or Android app (US$2.99, or ₱199 in the Philippines, shown in your local price), or in a web browser at klean.ph/account.html: sign in, then pay US$2.99 by card or ₱199 with GCash, Maya or QR Ph, and verify right there.
  2. Tap Start verification and follow the steps: hold a valid ID in front of the camera, then look at the camera for a quick selfie. There's no button to press: each photo is taken automatically once it's steady. For a quick check, use good light without glare, lay your ID flat on a dark surface, and remove glasses, hats and masks for the selfie.
  3. Most people are approved within a minute or two. After the last step the app shows Checking your verification…: keep Klean open and don't start again. Some checks take up to a day; we'll let you know.

Good to know:

  • The fee is charged per attempt and is non-refundable. If you close the verification window before finishing, tap Continue verification to reopen it at no extra cost.
  • Use a valid, unexpired ID, in good light, with nothing covering your face.
  • We don't keep a copy of your ID. Our verification partner, Didit, handles the images.
  • If we find you already have a Klean account, tap Use my existing account to continue with it.
  • While Klean is in testing, verification may be free (the app says so). Once you're verified, you stay verified.

Washing and drying

Self-service: scan a machine

  1. Go to a machine that isn't running.
  2. Tap Scan, and point your camera at the QR code on the machine.
  3. Choose how many loads (one load = one wash and one dry; up to 5) and pay once. The machine is held for you for about 10 minutes while you pay.
  4. When payment clears, the machine is ready. Press Start on the machine.
  5. Your dry is saved in your wallet. When the wash is done, scan any free dryer at the same laundromat business. No second payment. Home shows what's paid ("Your dry is paid", or "2 washes and 3 dries paid").
  6. Paid for more than one load? Scan the next free washer: it starts without payment. Saved loads last 30 days.

If the camera doesn't work, type the code printed under the QR.

With an attendant

  1. Hand your laundry to the attendant. They'll weigh it and tell you how many loads you need (one load per 8 kg, or your laundromat's limit).
  2. Scan the payment QR on their screen with your phone and pay.
  3. The attendant assigns your machines. Press Start when the light turns white.

To earn points on attendant-assisted visits, give the attendant the member code from Account. They'll add it to your order.

After you pay

The app tells you when your machine is ready. Press Start on the machine within a few minutes. If the machine shows an error, ask an attendant: your credit is safe.

If something goes wrong

  • You paid but the machine didn't start: check Home. If you see a wash credit, your money is safe. Scan any free washer at the same business and it starts without another payment.
  • The machine shows red after you paid: the credit goes back to your wallet automatically. Use another machine, or ask an attendant.
  • Load credits are valid for 30 days.

Points and free loads

  • You earn points every time you pay: usually 10 points per load, plus a 10-point welcome bonus on your first paid visit to a laundromat business.
  • 100 points = a free wash + dry (each business can set its own numbers; Home shows them).
  • Points belong to the business where you earned them. Points at one business work at all its branches, but not at a different business.
  • Claim a free load from Home → Claim free load. It's added to your wallet; scan a free washer to use it.
  • Points expire 12 months after you earn them. Free loads don't earn points.
  • Welcome load: new to Klean? Some laundromats give brand-new members their first wash + dry free. If you verified in the last 30 days and haven't done laundry on Klean yet, just scan a machine at a participating laundromat: it starts without payment. One welcome load per person. Verification is once for all of Klean; you never verify again for another laundromat.

Your account

  • Member code (Account): a code like KLN-7H3K-Q9MP. Give it to an attendant to earn points, or to a laundromat that wants to hire you. It can't be used to sign in or pay.
  • Sign-in methods: link Apple, Google and GitHub to the same account.
  • Start a laundromat business: see the Super Admin Manual.
  • Delete account: Account → Delete account. This removes your personal data and forfeits unused points and credits. It can't be undone.

Internet connection

Klean needs the internet to pay and start machines. If you lose connection, the app shows No internet connection until you're back on Wi-Fi or mobile data. A machine that's already running isn't affected.

Need help?

See the FAQ, or contact us: Account → Contact us in the app, email info@klean.ph, or call or text (619) 796-1115. Include your member code so we can find your account.
